subject: Single registry of the avatar/lifecycle hook surface

scope.in_scope: every hook the lifecycle oracle and its refining contracts define: the 9 framework avatar hooks and the 7 event hooks
scope.out_of_scope: the node module contract (init/start/message/before_request/http/after_request/on_error/tick/stop/shutdown/websocket_message/websocket_close) — already shipped and documented in docs/lua.md; it predates the avatar oracle and has no avatar-state landing point

thread_model: one Lua VM per gameServer/crossServer, invoked serially on its Asio thread (docs/lua.md); no two hooks ever interleave
reentrancy: excluded by construction (docs/avatar-runtime.md): the VM is serial, the framework never calls a second avatar hook while one runs, and a message handler cannot trigger a lifecycle transition synchronously — transitions are scheduled to a handler boundary

hooks.name: avatar_load
hooks.timing: an avatar is created at this host from a loaded record; entry to active only on success
hooks.thread: hosting node's Asio thread (gameServer or crossServer)
hooks.failure: load failed: no avatar is published, entry is refused with the cause (no visible avatar)
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_load (dot definition, no self); name provisional until implementation
hooks.source: docs/avatar-runtime.md (the Lua hook surface); docs/avatar-lifecycle.md (hook surface per state)

hooks.name: avatar_enter
hooks.timing: a session attaches to an active avatar
hooks.failure: entry refused with an explicit reason
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_enter; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: avatar_leave
hooks.timing: a session detaches (logout, evacuation); never blocks the detach
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_leave; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: avatar_tick
hooks.timing: node tick, active avatars only; cross-local only when visiting
hooks.failure: logged; the avatar stays (matches node tick semantics)
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_tick; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: avatar_save
hooks.timing: the single forced-save entry; in reclaiming the final save must be durable before closed; in the daily cutover it is the write barrier
hooks.failure: save failed: surfaced to the operator; retry belongs to the sender queue, not the hook
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_save; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: avatar_transfer_out
hooks.timing: this host stops hosting; the source flushes final ordered changes before tombstone
hooks.failure: transfer aborted; the avatar returns to active where it was
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_transfer_out; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: avatar_transfer_in
hooks.timing: this host takes over hosting; the load source is transfer-in
hooks.failure: the incoming avatar closes on this host; the source keeps its avatar
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_transfer_in; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: avatar_detach
hooks.failure: logged; the avatar goes suspended regardless
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_detach; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: avatar_fail
hooks.timing: any avatar hook failed or timed out; any state
hooks.failure: best effort: it may not run during a VM replacement; the original consequence stands
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.avatar_fail; name provisional until implementation

hooks.name: onAvatarDailyReset
hooks.timing: daily cutover barrier: per active/visiting avatar, after its avatar_save flushed durable; observes the flushed state
hooks.failure: logged; the flush stands (it is the barrier); the cutover proceeds
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.onAvatarDailyReset; notification hook, nil return

hooks.name: onDailyReset
hooks.timing: daily cutover barrier: per scene instance, after every avatar in it flushed (avatar layer before scene layer before node layer)
hooks.failure: logged; retried within the barrier; the barrier is not released until the layer's flush is durable
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.onDailyReset; notification hook, nil return

hooks.name: onCrossVisitAdmit
hooks.timing: cross admission: after the network quotas (ROOM_FULL/GROUP_FULL/SHARD_FULL) and the verified ticket, before the lease is granted
hooks.failure: hook error -> deny (fail closed); the reason is surfaced
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.onCrossVisitAdmit; gate hook, boolean/truthy return

hooks.name: onCrossVisitStart
hooks.timing: the visiting avatar was created at the crossServer
hooks.failure: logged; the visit proceeds (notification hook, never vetoes)
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.onCrossVisitStart; notification hook, nil return

hooks.name: onCrossVisitEnd
hooks.timing: the visiting avatar closed (returned or terminated)
hooks.failure: logged; the close proceeds (notification hook, never vetoes)
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.onCrossVisitEnd; notification hook, nil return

hooks.name: onLeaseTaken
hooks.timing: this host holds the writer lease
hooks.thread: hosting node's Asio thread (gameServer or crossServer)
hooks.failure: logged; the lease grant stands (notification hook)
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.onLeaseTaken; notification hook, nil return

hooks.name: onLeaseLost
hooks.timing: the lease expired or was taken over
hooks.thread: hosting node's Asio thread (gameServer or crossServer)
hooks.lua_surface: module-table function M.onLeaseLost; notification hook, nil return
